item.title: What chaos? Farage tries to distract with immigration plans | Politics Weekly UK
item.summary: Reform UK is not having a good time. This morning while announcing their latest immigration plans, Nigel Farage somehow reignited his spat with the Restore Britain leader, Rupert Lowe. To make matters worse Farage’s deputy, Richard Tice, is under investigation by the parliamentary standards watchdog. Are Reform UK’s rehashed immigration plans just a distraction from their internal party problems? Continue reading...
